IN PHOTOS: Manila Mayor Francisco ‘Isko Moreno’ Domagoso and Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon inspect the Nagtahan Link flyover in Pandacan, Manila on April 29, 2026, following reports of missing steel railings allegedly stolen from the structure. 

The inspection was prompted by safety concerns after incidents linked to the theft, which authorities say could endanger motorists and pedestrians. Reports noted that similar cases of stolen railings have contributed to accidents, including a fatal fall involving a motorcycle rider in Pandacan earlier this month. 

The Nagtahan Link Bridge, a key roadway connecting districts across Manila, is under DPWH jurisdiction and plays a vital role in daily traffic flow.

📸: Norman Cruz
